_help: Inventory items. sprite is relative to assets/sprites/. kind: key (opens key locks), tool (reveals hidden spots), part (combines into something), clue (readable). Names are shown to the player.

brass_key.text: A shiny brass key with a sun-shaped bow.

tiny_key.text: A tiny silver key. It must open something small.

old_key.text: An old iron key, whole again.
